Collection Maintenance Actively performs collection maintenance duties while maintaining current knowledge of, and implementing, all associated procedures and policies. Responsible for directing the work of student employees in Orbach Library, including training on all policies and tasks, assigning tasks, updating schedule changes on the student calendar, and addressing minor performance issues. Monitors accuracy of student employees' work and checks for completion of assignments, which may include walking all floors of the library, kneeling, reaching, and pushing loaded book trucks. Performs general and specialized search procedures for items not found in the stacks, which may include walking all of the library floors, bending, kneeling, reaching, and gripping. Uses the integrated library management system (Alma) to update and track items through all stages of the search process. Monitors Stacks areas (which may include walking all of the library floors on a regular basis, bending and reaching) and makes recommendations for workflow. Assists in maintaining shelves in excellent order. Ensures accuracy of shelving end panels (range guides), which requires reaching, bending, and use of a stepstool. Assists in organizing and maintaining the accuracy of items in the stacks. This includes the maintenance and creation of item records. Processes problem items, such as items without item records, incorrect information in item records, repair, or items in need of new labels. Interprets bibliographic records and sends items with complex bibliographic errors to appropriate units for correction. Responsible for shelving of non-standard materials such as WRCA, Maps, and Reference materials. (35% time)

Preservation Performs basic to mid-level preservation procedures, including applying dust jackets and cover ups, and repairing heads, tails, and hinges using specialized equipment such as the fast back machine. These duties require manual precision, including gripping, measuring, and cutting with an X-acto knife. Trains and directs student assistants in processing newly cataloged items, ensuring all materials remain organized on correctly labeled shelves and carts, which involves pushing loaded book trucks. Uses Alma to manage item movement, including transit and Preservation & Acquisitions work orders. Serves as backup for time-sensitive repairs and RUSH processing, and prepares books for bindery shipments, ensuring all required information is accurate and formatted correctly. (30% time)

Student Projects Directs student employees assigned to large-scale collection relocation projects, such as the Google book scanning initiative. Responsibilities include training on policies and tasks, assigning duties, managing student schedules, and addressing performance issues. Oversees continuous projects such as shelf reading and cleaning. Participates in planning and coordinating unit-wide efforts, including record clean-ups, shelf checks, and collection measurements. Manages project tracking through spreadsheets, ensuring timely quality checks and maintaining accurate statistics. Monitors student work accuracy and task completion, which involves physical duties such as navigating library floors, kneeling, reaching, and pushing loaded book trucks (30% time)

General Departmental and Library Responsibilities Special projects or other duties within the unit or library may be assigned. Participates in staff meetings and committees. May serve as Building Emergency Staff for the Orbach Library, responding to emergency situations in accordance with established procedures. May serve as an Alt-Building Supervisor for Emergency Conditions if a BSEC is unavailable. Interprets and is able to carry out library and campus-wide safety/emergency policies and procedures should the need occur. Reports safety and security hazards to the Unit Head. Monitors relevant mailing lists, department blog and other formal communication mechanisms. Other duties as assigned. (5% time)
